title: Data engineer iii
description:
Nova oportunidade para Data engineer iii em montenegro. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

Posição temporária! Visão Geral da Posição A equipe de Analytics de BMP (Business Model and Pricing) está buscando um(a) Engenheiro(a) de Dados experiente para apoiar a gestão de desempenho do negócio e a tomada de decisões estratégicas por meio de infraestrutura de dados escalável e soluções de engenharia. A equipe trabalha em estreita colaboração com liderança, finanças, operações e stakeholders do negócio para viabilizar acesso confiável a dados de alta qualidade, apoiar análises avançadas e impulsionar ações orientadas por dados em toda a organização. O(a) Engenheiro(a) de Dados terá um papel crítico no desenho, construção e manutenção de pipelines de dados robustos, modelos de dados e ativos fundamentais que suportam analytics, relatórios e capacidades emergentes de IA/ML. Essa função exige forte rigor em engenharia, profundo entendimento de sistemas de dados e capacidade de colaborar entre equipes técnicas e de negócio. O(a) candidato(a) ideal possui um histórico comprovado na construção de soluções de dados escaláveis em ambientes dinâmicos e multifuncionais, e sente-se confortável equilibrando trabalho em plataformas de dados fundamentais com iniciativas em evolução de analytics e IA. O que você fará Você possui uma forte mentalidade de engenharia e resolução de problemas. Converte necessidades de negócio e analíticas em soluções e arquiteturas de dados escaláveis e confiáveis. Projeta, constrói e mantém pipelines e modelos de dados escaláveis que suportam monitoramento de desempenho do negócio, analytics e relatórios, além de contribuir para o desenvolvimento da Base de Dados BMP em ambientes Hive, Snowflake e data lakes. Apoia o desenvolvimento de produtos e aplicações de dados, incluindo contribuição em pipelines baseados em Streamlit e no desenvolvimento de capacidades de chatbot para melhorar o acesso e a interação com dados. Colabora de perto com equipes de analytics, ciência de dados e áreas de negócio para garantir disponibilidade, qualidade e usabilidade dos dados para dashboards, relatórios e análises avançadas. Viabiliza e apoia o desenvolvimento de analytics avançado, machine learning e capacidades de IA, garantindo que a infraestrutura, pipelines e ambientes necessários estejam disponíveis para o desenvolvimento e implantação de modelos. Contribui para o design e evolução do ecossistema de dados e ML, ajudando a estabelecer infraestrutura, processos e fundamentos necessários para escalar iniciativas de IA/ML na organização. Qualificações Mínimas • Mestrado em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Dados, Engenharia ou área quantitativa relacionada. • Mais de 5 anos de experiência em engenharia de dados, desenvolvimento de plataformas de dados ou funções relacionadas. • Forte experiência com SQL e pelo menos uma linguagem de programação (Python ou equivalente). • Familiaridade com frameworks de big data e processamento distribuído (ex.: Spark / Py Spark). • Experiência na construção e manutenção de pipelines de dados e trabalho com arquiteturas modernas de dados. • Experiência com ferramentas de orquestração (ex.: Airflow) e automação de pipelines. • Experiência com plataformas de dados em nuvem (ex.: AWS) e soluções de data warehouse (ex.: Snowflake). • Sólido entendimento de modelagem de dados, qualidade de dados e governança de dados. • Experiência com sistemas de controle de versão (Git) e fluxos colaborativos de desenvolvimento. • Fortes habilidades de resolução de problemas e capacidade de trabalhar com requisitos ambíguos. • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e capacidade de colaborar com stakeholders técnicos e não técnicos. • Inglês fluente. Qualificações Desejáveis • Experiência com arquiteturas de data lake e ambientes de dados híbridos. • Experiência com suporte a pipelines e infraestrutura de machine learning. • Experiência com aplicações de dados (ex.: Streamlit) e interfaces conversacionais (chatbots). • Experiência com ferramentas e práticas de desenvolvimento assistido por IA. • Experiência contribuindo para documentação e plataformas de compartilhamento de conhecimento (ex.: Confluence). • Experiência em organizações globais com estrutura matricial.

Experiência na criação de relatórios complexos utilizando Smart View, FRS, BI Publisher e OTBI. Forte conhecimento de ferramentas de integração como FBDI, Webservices e familiaridade com OIC, incluindo componentes Oracle Paa S. Experiência na criação de documentos de design funcional para objetos RICE e na coordenação com equipes técnicas e funcionais durante design, desenvolvimento, testes e implantação. title: Data engineer iii
description:
Empresa está contratando Data engineer iii em presidente prudente. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Posição temporária! Visão Geral da Posição A equipe de Analytics de BMP (Business Model and Pricing) está buscando um(a) Engenheiro(a) de Dados experiente para apoiar a gestão de desempenho do negócio e a tomada de decisões estratégicas por meio de infraestrutura de dados escalável e soluções de engenharia. A equipe trabalha em estreita colaboração com liderança, finanças, operações e stakeholders do negócio para viabilizar acesso confiável a dados de alta qualidade, apoiar análises avançadas e impulsionar ações orientadas por dados em toda a organização. O(a) Engenheiro(a) de Dados terá um papel crítico no desenho, construção e manutenção de pipelines de dados robustos, modelos de dados e ativos fundamentais que suportam analytics, relatórios e capacidades emergentes de IA/ML. Essa função exige forte rigor em engenharia, profundo entendimento de sistemas de dados e capacidade de colaborar entre equipes técnicas e de negócio. O(a) candidato(a) ideal possui um histórico comprovado na construção de soluções de dados escaláveis em ambientes dinâmicos e multifuncionais, e sente-se confortável equilibrando trabalho em plataformas de dados fundamentais com iniciativas em evolução de analytics e IA. O que você fará Você possui uma forte mentalidade de engenharia e resolução de problemas. Converte necessidades de negócio e analíticas em soluções e arquiteturas de dados escaláveis e confiáveis. Projeta, constrói e mantém pipelines e modelos de dados escaláveis que suportam monitoramento de desempenho do negócio, analytics e relatórios, além de contribuir para o desenvolvimento da Base de Dados BMP em ambientes Hive, Snowflake e data lakes. Apoia o desenvolvimento de produtos e aplicações de dados, incluindo contribuição em pipelines baseados em Streamlit e no desenvolvimento de capacidades de chatbot para melhorar o acesso e a interação com dados. Position Overview:   We invite researchers and scientists to join us as  Section Editor  for the journal, " Current Cell Science"  , to contribute to a research area (section) most relevant to their field of expertise. Qualifications and Experience:   • Ph. How To Apply:   Interested candidates are invited to submit their CVs; list of publications, and a Topical issue proposal by 25 May 2026. The proposal should include the title and scope of the Topical issue, relevant keywords, sub-topics, and preferably, the article titles, a list of potential contributors, and article submission deadlines.  Special Instructions:   • Each author/co-author is welcome to contribute one paper to the Topical Issue.  • Contributions must adhere to topics approved by the Editor-in-Chief.  • Manuscript submission extensions will be limited to 60 days. title: Senior web developer
description:
Confira a vaga para Senior web developer em remote. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

About the Role  We're looking for a Modern Web Developer to design, build, and ship high-quality websites across our agency group — primarily in Word Press and Hub Spot, but increasingly using AI-native build tools like Lovable, Claude Code, and Cursor.  This is not a classic Word Press role buried in PHP. We need someone who is technically broad and modern: comfortable in a CMS, fluent in modern Java Script and APIs, and excited to use AI coding tools to ship faster than a traditional dev shop. You'll build marketing sites, landing pages, and lightweight web apps — and just as often, wire those sites into the rest of our stack via APIs, webhooks, and automations.  If you love shipping polished, conversion-ready sites and you're allergic to bloated,  brittle Word Press builds, you'll fit right in.  Key Responsibilities   Website Development   Design and build production-grade marketing websites in Word Press (custom themes/blocks, ACF, headless setups where appropriate) and Hub Spot CMS (Hub L templating, modules, themes).  Use Lovable, Claude Code, Cursor, and similar AI-native tools to accelerate  prototyping and full builds — for client work and internal tools alike.  Build clean, performant, accessible front-end experiences (semantic HTML, modern CSS, vanilla JS or framework-as-needed).  Maintain and extend existing client sites: new pages, modules, redesigns, performance tuning, and migrations.    API Integrations & Automation Hooks   Integrate websites with Hub Spot, Salesforce, marketing automation platforms, analytics tools, and custom APIs.  Wire up form submissions, gated content, and lead routing to webhooks, n8n flows, and serverless functions.  Build lightweight internal tools, microsites, and utilities when a full CMS is overkill (Vercel, Netlify, Cloudflare Workers, etc.).    Quality, Performance & SEO   Own Core Web Vitals, page speed, schema markup, and on-page technical SEO basics for every site you ship.  Implement analytics and tracking correctly (GA4, GTM, Hub Spot tracking, server-side events where needed).  Test thoroughly across devices and browsers; care about the details.    Collaboration   Work directly with designers, strategists, and marketers to translate Figma into pixel-faithful, on-brand builds.  Participate in code reviews, version control workflows (Git/Git Hub), and documentation.  Help define internal standards for how we build sites across the agency group going forward.    Required Skills   Technical   3+ years building production websites in Word Press (custom themes, blocks, ACF, plugin selection and customization).  Strong Hub Spot CMS experience (Hub L, modules, themes, forms, smart content).  Proficient in HTML, CSS, Java Script — comfortable with modern tooling, build steps, and at least one JS framework when needed (React/Next.js a plus).  Hands-on experience with AI coding tools (Lovable, Claude Code, Cursor, Replit, or equivalent) — and a clear point of view on when to use them vs. when to write code yourself.  Solid understanding of REST APIs, webhooks, OAuth, and serverless functions.  Comfortable in Git/Git Hub with branching, PRs, and basic CI/CD.    Modern Web Skills   Performance optimization (Core Web Vitals, lazy loading, image optimization, caching strategies).  Technical SEO fundamentals (schema, sitemaps, redirects, canonical handling).  Accessibility basics (WCAG, semantic HTML, keyboard navigation).  Analytics and tag management (GA4, GTM, server-side tracking).    Bonus Experience   (Not required, but highly valuable) Webflow development experience.  Headless Word Press or Hub Spot setups (Next.js + WP/Hub Spot APIs).  Experience with Supabase, Postgres, or Firebase for lightweight app backends.  Familiarity with n8n, Make.com, or Zapier for stitching sites into broader workflows.  E-commerce experience (Woo Commerce, Shopify).  Design sensibility — you can read a Figma file and notice when something is off without being told.    Soft Skills   Bias toward shipping. You'd rather get a working v1 live than debate architecture for two weeks.  Detail-oriented — you care about pixel alignment, spacing, and typography as much as the underlying code.  Strong communicator with non-technical teammates; you can explain trade-offs to a strategist or account lead without jargon.  Curious about new tools and models — you experiment on your own time and bring ideas back to the team.  Comfortable juggling multiple sites and clients in a fast-moving agency environment.    What Success Looks Like   In the first 60–90 days, you will:  Ship at least 2–3 client websites or major redesigns end-to-end.  Establish standards for how we use AI coding tools across web builds (when to reach for Lovable, when to drop into Claude Code, when to write it ourselves).  Integrate at least one site deeply with our automation stack (Hub Spot, n8n, custom APIs) in a way that becomes a reusable pattern.  Become the internal go-to person for technical web questions across the agency group.

title: Senior web developer
description:
Confira a vaga para Senior web developer em taubaté. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

About the Role  We're looking for a Modern Web Developer to design, build, and ship high-quality websites across our agency group — primarily in Word Press and Hub Spot, but increasingly using AI-native build tools like Lovable, Claude Code, and Cursor.  This is not a classic Word Press role buried in PHP. We need someone who is technically broad and modern: comfortable in a CMS, fluent in modern Java Script and APIs, and excited to use AI coding tools to ship faster than a traditional dev shop. You'll build marketing sites, landing pages, and lightweight web apps — and just as often, wire those sites into the rest of our stack via APIs, webhooks, and automations.  If you love shipping polished, conversion-ready sites and you're allergic to bloated,  brittle Word Press builds, you'll fit right in.  Key Responsibilities   Website Development   Design and build production-grade marketing websites in Word Press (custom themes/blocks, ACF, headless setups where appropriate) and Hub Spot CMS (Hub L templating, modules, themes).  Use Lovable, Claude Code, Cursor, and similar AI-native tools to accelerate  prototyping and full builds — for client work and internal tools alike.  Build clean, performant, accessible front-end experiences (semantic HTML, modern CSS, vanilla JS or framework-as-needed).  Maintain and extend existing client sites: new pages, modules, redesigns, performance tuning, and migrations.    API Integrations & Automation Hooks   Integrate websites with Hub Spot, Salesforce, marketing automation platforms, analytics tools, and custom APIs.  Wire up form submissions, gated content, and lead routing to webhooks, n8n flows, and serverless functions.  Build lightweight internal tools, microsites, and utilities when a full CMS is overkill (Vercel, Netlify, Cloudflare Workers, etc.).    Quality, Performance & SEO   Own Core Web Vitals, page speed, schema markup, and on-page technical SEO basics for every site you ship.  Implement analytics and tracking correctly (GA4, GTM, Hub Spot tracking, server-side events where needed).  Test thoroughly across devices and browsers; care about the details.    Collaboration   Work directly with designers, strategists, and marketers to translate Figma into pixel-faithful, on-brand builds.  Participate in code reviews, version control workflows (Git/Git Hub), and documentation.  Help define internal standards for how we build sites across the agency group going forward.    Required Skills   Technical   3+ years building production websites in Word Press (custom themes, blocks, ACF, plugin selection and customization).  Strong Hub Spot CMS experience (Hub L, modules, themes, forms, smart content).  Proficient in HTML, CSS, Java Script — comfortable with modern tooling, build steps, and at least one JS framework when needed (React/Next.js a plus).  Hands-on experience with AI coding tools (Lovable, Claude Code, Cursor, Replit, or equivalent) — and a clear point of view on when to use them vs. when to write code yourself.  Solid understanding of REST APIs, webhooks, OAuth, and serverless functions.  Comfortable in Git/Git Hub with branching, PRs, and basic CI/CD.    Modern Web Skills   Performance optimization (Core Web Vitals, lazy loading, image optimization, caching strategies).  Technical SEO fundamentals (schema, sitemaps, redirects, canonical handling).  Accessibility basics (WCAG, semantic HTML, keyboard navigation).  Analytics and tag management (GA4, GTM, server-side tracking).    Bonus Experience   (Not required, but highly valuable) Webflow development experience.  Headless Word Press or Hub Spot setups (Next.js + WP/Hub Spot APIs).  Experience with Supabase, Postgres, or Firebase for lightweight app backends.  Familiarity with n8n, Make.com, or Zapier for stitching sites into broader workflows.  E-commerce experience (Woo Commerce, Shopify).  Design sensibility — you can read a Figma file and notice when something is off without being told.    Soft Skills   Bias toward shipping. You'd rather get a working v1 live than debate architecture for two weeks.  Detail-oriented — you care about pixel alignment, spacing, and typography as much as the underlying code.  Strong communicator with non-technical teammates; you can explain trade-offs to a strategist or account lead without jargon.  Curious about new tools and models — you experiment on your own time and bring ideas back to the team.  Comfortable juggling multiple sites and clients in a fast-moving agency environment.    What Success Looks Like   In the first 60–90 days, you will:  Ship at least 2–3 client websites or major redesigns end-to-end.  Establish standards for how we use AI coding tools across web builds (when to reach for Lovable, when to drop into Claude Code, when to write it ourselves).  Integrate at least one site deeply with our automation stack (Hub Spot, n8n, custom APIs) in a way that becomes a reusable pattern.  Become the internal go-to person for technical web questions across the agency group.

title: Senior web developer
description:
Confira a vaga para Senior web developer em valinhos. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

About the Role  We're looking for a Modern Web Developer to design, build, and ship high-quality websites across our agency group — primarily in Word Press and Hub Spot, but increasingly using AI-native build tools like Lovable, Claude Code, and Cursor.  This is not a classic Word Press role buried in PHP. We need someone who is technically broad and modern: comfortable in a CMS, fluent in modern Java Script and APIs, and excited to use AI coding tools to ship faster than a traditional dev shop. You'll build marketing sites, landing pages, and lightweight web apps — and just as often, wire those sites into the rest of our stack via APIs, webhooks, and automations.  If you love shipping polished, conversion-ready sites and you're allergic to bloated,  brittle Word Press builds, you'll fit right in.  Key Responsibilities   Website Development   Design and build production-grade marketing websites in Word Press (custom themes/blocks, ACF, headless setups where appropriate) and Hub Spot CMS (Hub L templating, modules, themes).  Use Lovable, Claude Code, Cursor, and similar AI-native tools to accelerate  prototyping and full builds — for client work and internal tools alike.  Build clean, performant, accessible front-end experiences (semantic HTML, modern CSS, vanilla JS or framework-as-needed).  Maintain and extend existing client sites: new pages, modules, redesigns, performance tuning, and migrations.    API Integrations & Automation Hooks   Integrate websites with Hub Spot, Salesforce, marketing automation platforms, analytics tools, and custom APIs.  Wire up form submissions, gated content, and lead routing to webhooks, n8n flows, and serverless functions.  Build lightweight internal tools, microsites, and utilities when a full CMS is overkill (Vercel, Netlify, Cloudflare Workers, etc.).    Quality, Performance & SEO   Own Core Web Vitals, page speed, schema markup, and on-page technical SEO basics for every site you ship.  Implement analytics and tracking correctly (GA4, GTM, Hub Spot tracking, server-side events where needed).  Test thoroughly across devices and browsers; care about the details.    Collaboration   Work directly with designers, strategists, and marketers to translate Figma into pixel-faithful, on-brand builds.  Participate in code reviews, version control workflows (Git/Git Hub), and documentation.  Help define internal standards for how we build sites across the agency group going forward.    Required Skills   Technical   3+ years building production websites in Word Press (custom themes, blocks, ACF, plugin selection and customization).  Strong Hub Spot CMS experience (Hub L, modules, themes, forms, smart content).  Proficient in HTML, CSS, Java Script — comfortable with modern tooling, build steps, and at least one JS framework when needed (React/Next.js a plus).  Hands-on experience with AI coding tools (Lovable, Claude Code, Cursor, Replit, or equivalent) — and a clear point of view on when to use them vs. when to write code yourself.  Solid understanding of REST APIs, webhooks, OAuth, and serverless functions.  Comfortable in Git/Git Hub with branching, PRs, and basic CI/CD.    Modern Web Skills   Performance optimization (Core Web Vitals, lazy loading, image optimization, caching strategies).  Technical SEO fundamentals (schema, sitemaps, redirects, canonical handling).  Accessibility basics (WCAG, semantic HTML, keyboard navigation).  Analytics and tag management (GA4, GTM, server-side tracking).    Bonus Experience   (Not required, but highly valuable) Webflow development experience.  Headless Word Press or Hub Spot setups (Next.js + WP/Hub Spot APIs).  Experience with Supabase, Postgres, or Firebase for lightweight app backends.  Familiarity with n8n, Make.com, or Zapier for stitching sites into broader workflows.  E-commerce experience (Woo Commerce, Shopify).  Design sensibility — you can read a Figma file and notice when something is off without being told.    Soft Skills   Bias toward shipping. You'd rather get a working v1 live than debate architecture for two weeks.  Detail-oriented — you care about pixel alignment, spacing, and typography as much as the underlying code.  Strong communicator with non-technical teammates; you can explain trade-offs to a strategist or account lead without jargon.  Curious about new tools and models — you experiment on your own time and bring ideas back to the team.  Comfortable juggling multiple sites and clients in a fast-moving agency environment.    What Success Looks Like   In the first 60–90 days, you will:  Ship at least 2–3 client websites or major redesigns end-to-end.  Establish standards for how we use AI coding tools across web builds (when to reach for Lovable, when to drop into Claude Code, when to write it ourselves).  Integrate at least one site deeply with our automation stack (Hub Spot, n8n, custom APIs) in a way that becomes a reusable pattern.  Become the internal go-to person for technical web questions across the agency group.

MOBI7 A Mobi7 é uma empresa que utiliza a tecnologia para criar soluções que otimizam a mobilidade, auxiliam na gestão e valorizam a segurança no trânsito. Hoje, nós fazemos parte das empresas da Localiza e temos uma plataforma de gestão de frotas corporativas, criada para monitorar e otimizar o uso de veículos leves ou pesados. E esse é só o começo  O QUE BUSCAMOS:   Buscamos um(a)  Especialista em Data Ops  para liderar a padronização e evolução da nossa plataforma de dados.  O foco principal será desenvolver  módulos Terraform reutilizáveis  , estruturando a base de infraestrutura que suporta nossos pipelines e produtos de dados.  É uma função para alguém com forte senioridade técnica, atuando na interseção entre  engenharia de dados  ,  cloud  e  automação  .  Responsabilidades e atribuições    Criar e evoluir  módulos Terraform  para padronizar componentes da plataforma de dados (redes, IAM, storage, computação, pipelines etc.);   Arquitetar, desenvolver e manter  pipelines e processos ETL/ELT  , garantindo qualidade, escalabilidade e observabilidade;   Estabelecer padrões e boas práticas de  Data Ops  , incluindo versionamento, testes, deployments e monitoramento;   Dar suporte técnico e consultivo aos times de dados, ajudando a estruturar soluções robustas e alinhadas à arquitetura corporativa;  Implementar mecanismos de  governança  , segurança e otimização de custos em ambientes de dados na nuvem.    Requisitos obrigatórios    Experiência sólida com  Terraform  e infraestrutura como código;   Vivência prática em  cloud  (AWS, Azure ou GCP), especialmente em serviços de dados;   Forte conhecimento em  pipelines  ,  ETL/ELT  e arquiteturas de dados (Data Lake, DW, Lakehouse);   Proficiência em  Python  e  SQL;    Experiência com  CI/CD  aplicado a dados e automação;   Conhecimentos de containers (Docker) e, desejável, Kubernetes.    Diferenciais   Criação de bibliotecas ou módulos Terraform em escala corporativa;  Experiência com orquestradores como Airflow, Prefect, Dagster ou Step Functions;  Conhecimento de ferramentas de monitoramento e observabilidade (Cloud Watch, Grafana, Datadog);  Certificações cloud ou de engenharia de dados.    Perfil comportamental   Liderança técnica e capacidade de influenciar padrões e boas práticas;  Comunicação clara para dialogar com áreas técnicas e não técnicas;  Proatividade e visão sistêmica de plataforma.    BENEFÍ CIOS DESSA POSIÇÃ O   Participação em Lucros e Resultados;  Carro Corporativo;  Descontos em Aluguel, Assinatura e Compra de veículos;  Programa de Livre Escolha (Reembolso de Despesas Médicas);  Vale Alimentação e Refeição;  Allya;  Auxílio Home office;  Wellhub;  Plano de Saúde;  Plano Odontológico;  Seguro de Vida.

title: Direct-response creative strategist
description:
Empresa está contratando Direct-response creative strategist em americana. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

About us Clickbait Agency is a You Tube ad creative and media buying agency. We only work with 8 and 9-figure DTC brands and our focus is simple, producing video creatives that scale profitably on You Tube and this means that you’ll be working directly on accounts most agencies don’t get near.  We care deeply about being the best at what we do which means fast iteration, high standards, and creatives that spend millions. We’ve built proprietary AI systems that support our creative and production workflows, and our video production runs through a dedicated team of AI prompters, so strategists can stay focused on strategy.  We think You Tube creative is going through a significant shift right now and we’re positioning ourselves at the front of it.  The role  We’re looking for a creative strategist who understands direct response at a serious level and can develop and script You Tube ads and mini VSLs for competitive ecommerce markets.  You’ll be responsible for research, angle development, hook writing, scripting, and iterating based on performance data. Your scripts go through our AI production team, so the output is fast and the feedback loop is short.  You’ll be working across multiple 8 and 9-figure brands simultaneously. The work is demanding and the bar is high.  What we’re looking for  We’re only looking for people who are genuinely good at this. If you’re earlier in your career or still developing your DR fundamentals, this isn’t the right fit yet.  You should have:  2+ years writing direct response video ads for You Tube or Facebook  A real understanding of Eugene Schwartz’s awareness stages and how to apply them to cold traffic  Experience scripting hooks, mini VSLs, and full ad concepts  The ability to look at performance data and use it to build the next creative  Proven spend behind your work — creatives you’ve written that have run profitably at scale  Comfort using AI tools as part of your day-to-day workflow    Experience in compliance-sensitive categories like supplements or weight loss is a bonus. So is familiarity with unique mechanism development and RMBC.  What we offer  Base salary with a performance bonus tied to winning creatives. When your work scales, your compensation reflects that.  You’ll have access to proprietary AI tools built specifically for our workflow, a production team that handles execution, and a team around you that takes the work seriously.  This is a fully remote position.  One thing worth knowing  There’s a short test task as part of the application process. It’s there to see how you think, not to take your time for nothing. description:
Confira a vaga para ? operations & project manager | lifesupplyusa | remote em montenegro. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

Operations & Project Manager | Life Supply USA | Remote | Latin America  How to Apply   We do not accept applications through Linked In.   To be considered, please record a short Loom video (2 to 3 minutes) introducing yourself, describing a project or process you have owned end-to-end, and explaining why this role is the right next step for you. Applications without a Loom will not be reviewed. Send your video link and resume to  .   About Us   Life Supply USA is one of the fastest-growing e-commerce retailers of household essentials in the United States, specializing in air filters, HVAC filters, extension cords, and home goods. We operate across Amazon, Shopify, Walmart, and additional marketplaces with a lean, high-performance remote team. We are scaling fast and hiring the person who will keep the entire operation running like a machine.  The Role   We are hiring an  Operations & Project Manager  to serve as the execution backbone of the business and the primary management layer between our COO and our team.  This is  not  a coordinator role. This is a real management position with real authority.  You will own our operational rhythm, enforce accountability across every function, resolve blockers before they become problems, and ensure the entire team executes with precision, without the COO needing to be involved in day-to-day issues.  If things fall through the cracks, it is your job to catch them before anyone else notices.  Remote | Growth path to COO  What You Will Own    Click Up Environment  Own the Click Up workspace as the single source of truth for all work in progress. Enforce task hygiene daily. Audit weekly. Onboard new team members to standards.   Deadline Tracking & Escalation  Monitor all active tasks and projects for deadline risk proactively. Maintain a weekly at-risk task list. Surface root cause analysis to the COO when patterns emerge.   Meeting Cadence Ownership  Own all recurring meetings end to end: Daily Standup, Weekly 1:1s, COO Operations Review, Project Kickoffs, and Monthly Ops Review. Agendas distributed 24 hours in advance. Notes and action items distributed within 24 hours of each meeting.   Cross-Team Coordination & Blocker Resolution  Serve as the coordination layer between all functions. No team member should be stuck on a blocker for more than 24 hours without a resolution plan.   Workload & Priority Management  Monitor workload distribution across the team. Surface imbalances to the COO with recommended reallocation before output is affected.   KPI Dashboard Management  Own the weekly KPI reporting cycle. Compile and present the consolidated dashboard to the COO weekly. Flag all missed KPIs immediately with root cause and action plan.   Operational SOP Library  Own the company's full SOP library. Every recurring operational workflow documented and current.   Team Accountability  Hold every team member directly accountable for tasks, deadlines, and Click Up hygiene, without involving the COO in routine accountability conversations.  Your KPI Scorecard   ✅ Click Up Task Hygiene (owner + due date + status): 98%+ ✅ Deadline Adherence Rate: 90%+ ✅ Overdue Task Rate: 5% or less ✅ Meeting Agenda Coverage: 100% ✅ KPI Dashboard Timeliness: 100% ✅ SOP Coverage: 100% What You Will Need  ✅ ✔ Proven experience in operations management or project management in a fast-paced remote environment ✔ Strong hands-on experience with Click Up (required) or equivalent PM tools (Monday.com, Asana, Notion) ✔ Experience managing or coordinating a distributed, cross-functional team ✔ Exceptional organizational skills with a bias toward action, clarity, and follow-through ✔ Ability to make independent judgment calls and resolve issues without constant escalation ✔ Excellent written and spoken English ✔ Experience building and maintaining SOPs and operational documentation ✔ E-commerce or operations background is a strong plus ✔ Self-motivated, highly organized, and committed to a single full-time role  Your Authority   You will have real, day-to-day management authority to:  Reprioritize tasks and reassign workload across the team  Hold team members accountable for missed deadlines  Resolve cross-team blockers and coordination conflicts  Give direct feedback on execution standards  Make judgment calls on task sequencing and urgency  Approve minor process changes that do not affect KPIs or strategy    Growth Path   Operations & Project Manager → Senior Operations Manager →  Chief Operating Officer   The growth path is real. Phase 1 is about building credibility through execution discipline and demonstrating the judgment to manage independently.  What We Offer   Competitive base salary plus performance bonuses 100% remote Paid time off Clear, defined path to COO Real management authority from day one A lean, high-performance team that values direct communication and results  Important Notes  ⚠️ No freelancers or part-time applicants Gross salary — candidate handles own taxes Full commitment required: no other clients or roles  How to Apply   We do not accept applications through Linked In.   To be considered, please record a short Loom video (2 to 3 minutes) introducing yourself, describing a project or process you have owned end-to-end, and explaining why this role is the right next step for you. Applications without a Loom will not be reviewed. Send your video link and resume to  .   We are moving quickly. Strong candidates will hear back fast.

Gestão de Contencioso e Arbitragem:  Coordenar a contratação e atuação de escritórios externos, acompanhando processos estratégicos, prazos legais e procedimentos arbitrais, com foco em eficiência, qualidade técnica e alinhamento aos interesses da companhia.  Suporte a Operações Financeiras:  Apoiar juridicamente as demandas da Diretoria Financeira, incluindo a contratação e gestão de assessorias externas relacionadas a operações financeiras e estruturadas.  Relacionamento com Escritórios Jurídicos:  Desenvolver e manter relacionamento com escritórios de advocacia de referência e boutiques especializadas, garantindo acesso a expertise técnica de alto nível conforme a necessidade.  Gestão de Equipe:  Liderar e desenvolver o time jurídico, promovendo um ambiente de alta performance, com foco em qualidade das entregas, cumprimento de prazos e desenvolvimento profissional da equipe.  Compliance e Governança:  Assegurar o cumprimento das normas internas, políticas corporativas e exigências regulatórias, em alinhamento com as áreas responsáveis, fortalecendo a cultura de integridade e governança.  Melhoria de Processos:  Revisar e aprimorar continuamente os processos internos da área jurídica, buscando eficiência operacional, inovação e alinhamento às melhores práticas de mercado.  Requisitos obrigatório e Diferenciais:   Sólida trajetória jurídica com foco comprovado no  Setor Elétrico  .  Experiência prática em comercializadoras, geradoras ou consultorias especializadas.  Conhecimento das normas da CCEE e resoluções da ANEEL.  Perfil resolutivo e autonomia para gerir escritórios terceiros, fluxos de trabalho de ponta a ponta e o time jurídico.  OAB ativa e disponibilidade para atuação presencial em Curitiba/PR.  Pós-graduação em Direito da Energia ou Direito Regulatório.  Experiência em estruturação financeiras.  Experiência em Recuperação Judicial e/ou Extrajudicial  Por se tratar de uma empresa com estrutura enxuta, a atuação será marcada por protagonismo e forte execução. O(a) profissional será o principal ponto focal jurídico da companhia, o que exige um perfil “mão na massa”, atuando desde a elaboração minuciosa de petições e contratos até discussões técnicas junto à diretoria.  Haverá interação constante e colaboração direta com a mesa de operações, equipe comercial e áreas administrativa e financeira. O dia a dia será caracterizado por alta autonomia, com expectativa de gestão eficiente das próprias demandas e prazos, bem como resolução de desafios complexos com agilidade e rigor técnico. Senior Out Systems Engineer  About the Role   We are seeking a Senior Out Systems Engineer to lead platform stabilization and migration readiness efforts for a large-scale clinical application supporting 130+ locations nationwide. integrations impacting system performance  Reduce Error Noise and Improve Observability   Identify and remediate recurring error patterns masking real issues  Refactor exception handling and Capture business logic embedded within the platform  Identify core business logic vs platform-generated components  Advise on migration sequencing and risk across workflows  What You Bring   Required including query tuning and data model improvements  Experience refactoring complex, tightly coupled systems into modular architectures  Strong SQL Server performance tuning experience including execution plans and indexing  Hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines and deployment automation within Out Systems  Strong problem-solving skills in live production environments  Preferred Experience   Experience supporting or leading Out Systems to custom platform migrations  Background in healthcare or clinical systems with understanding of critical workflows  Familiarity with HIPAA considerations and secure data handling  Experience with license optimization and application object management  Knowledge of integration patterns across scheduling, e-signature, or CRM systems  Working Environment   Collaborate closely with internal engineering and PM leadership  Operate with high autonomy and ownership of technical decisions  Work within a live production environment supporting critical clinical operations  Balance speed and precision while minimizing risk to end users  This is a unique opportunity to step into a complex, high-visibility system, make immediate impact, and shape the foundation for a next-generation platform.

description:

About us Clickbait Agency is a You Tube ad creative and media buying agency. We only work with 8 and 9-figure DTC brands and our focus is simple, producing video creatives that scale profitably on You Tube and this means that you’ll be working directly on accounts most agencies don’t get near.  We care deeply about being the best at what we do which means fast iteration, high standards, and creatives that spend millions. We’ve built proprietary AI systems that support our creative and production workflows, and our video production runs through a dedicated team of AI prompters, so strategists can stay focused on strategy.  We think You Tube creative is going through a significant shift right now and we’re positioning ourselves at the front of it.  The role  We’re looking for a creative strategist who understands direct response at a serious level and can develop and script You Tube ads and mini VSLs for competitive ecommerce markets.  You’ll be responsible for research, angle development, hook writing, scripting, and iterating based on performance data. Your scripts go through our AI production team, so the output is fast and the feedback loop is short.  You’ll be working across multiple 8 and 9-figure brands simultaneously. The work is demanding and the bar is high.  What we’re looking for  We’re only looking for people who are genuinely good at this. If you’re earlier in your career or still developing your DR fundamentals, this isn’t the right fit yet.  You should have:  2+ years writing direct response video ads for You Tube or Facebook  A real understanding of Eugene Schwartz’s awareness stages and how to apply them to cold traffic  Experience scripting hooks, mini VSLs, and full ad concepts  The ability to look at performance data and use it to build the next creative  Proven spend behind your work — creatives you’ve written that have run profitably at scale  Comfort using AI tools as part of your day-to-day workflow    Experience in compliance-sensitive categories like supplements or weight loss is a bonus. So is familiarity with unique mechanism development and RMBC.  What we offer  Base salary with a performance bonus tied to winning creatives. When your work scales, your compensation reflects that.  You’ll have access to proprietary AI tools built specifically for our workflow, a production team that handles execution, and a team around you that takes the work seriously.  This is a fully remote position.  One thing worth knowing  There’s a short test task as part of the application process. It’s there to see how you think, not to take your time for nothing. title: Senior web developer
description:
Confira a vaga para Senior web developer em itupeva. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

About the Role  We're looking for a Modern Web Developer to design, build, and ship high-quality websites across our agency group — primarily in Word Press and Hub Spot, but increasingly using AI-native build tools like Lovable, Claude Code, and Cursor.  This is not a classic Word Press role buried in PHP. We need someone who is technically broad and modern: comfortable in a CMS, fluent in modern Java Script and APIs, and excited to use AI coding tools to ship faster than a traditional dev shop. You'll build marketing sites, landing pages, and lightweight web apps — and just as often, wire those sites into the rest of our stack via APIs, webhooks, and automations.  If you love shipping polished, conversion-ready sites and you're allergic to bloated,  brittle Word Press builds, you'll fit right in.  Key Responsibilities   Website Development   Design and build production-grade marketing websites in Word Press (custom themes/blocks, ACF, headless setups where appropriate) and Hub Spot CMS (Hub L templating, modules, themes).  Use Lovable, Claude Code, Cursor, and similar AI-native tools to accelerate  prototyping and full builds — for client work and internal tools alike.  Build clean, performant, accessible front-end experiences (semantic HTML, modern CSS, vanilla JS or framework-as-needed).  Maintain and extend existing client sites: new pages, modules, redesigns, performance tuning, and migrations.    API Integrations & Automation Hooks   Integrate websites with Hub Spot, Salesforce, marketing automation platforms, analytics tools, and custom APIs.  Wire up form submissions, gated content, and lead routing to webhooks, n8n flows, and serverless functions.  Build lightweight internal tools, microsites, and utilities when a full CMS is overkill (Vercel, Netlify, Cloudflare Workers, etc.).    Quality, Performance & SEO   Own Core Web Vitals, page speed, schema markup, and on-page technical SEO basics for every site you ship.  Implement analytics and tracking correctly (GA4, GTM, Hub Spot tracking, server-side events where needed).  Test thoroughly across devices and browsers; care about the details.    Collaboration   Work directly with designers, strategists, and marketers to translate Figma into pixel-faithful, on-brand builds.  Participate in code reviews, version control workflows (Git/Git Hub), and documentation.  Help define internal standards for how we build sites across the agency group going forward.    Required Skills   Technical   3+ years building production websites in Word Press (custom themes, blocks, ACF, plugin selection and customization). Modern Web Skills   Performance optimization (Core Web Vitals, lazy loading, image optimization, caching strategies).  Technical SEO fundamentals (schema, sitemaps, redirects, canonical handling).  Accessibility basics (WCAG, semantic HTML, keyboard navigation).  Analytics and tag management (GA4, GTM, server-side tracking). E-commerce experience (Woo Commerce, Shopify).  Design sensibility — you can read a Figma file and notice when something is off without being told.    Soft Skills   Bias toward shipping. You'd rather get a working v1 live than debate architecture for two weeks.  Detail-oriented — you care about pixel alignment, spacing, and typography as much as the underlying code.  Strong communicator with non-technical teammates; you can explain trade-offs to a strategist or account lead without jargon. Establish standards for how we use AI coding tools across web builds (when to reach for Lovable, when to drop into Claude Code, when to write it ourselves).  Integrate at least one site deeply with our automation stack (Hub Spot, n8n, custom APIs) in a way that becomes a reusable pattern.  Become the internal go-to person for technical web questions across the agency group.

MOBI7 A Mobi7 é uma empresa que utiliza a tecnologia para criar soluções que otimizam a mobilidade, auxiliam na gestão e valorizam a segurança no trânsito. Hoje, nós fazemos parte das empresas da Localiza e temos uma plataforma de gestão de frotas corporativas, criada para monitorar e otimizar o uso de veículos leves ou pesados. E esse é só o começo  O QUE BUSCAMOS:   Buscamos um(a)  Especialista em Data Ops  para liderar a padronização e evolução da nossa plataforma de dados.  O foco principal será desenvolver  módulos Terraform reutilizáveis  , estruturando a base de infraestrutura que suporta nossos pipelines e produtos de dados.  É uma função para alguém com forte senioridade técnica, atuando na interseção entre  engenharia de dados  ,  cloud  e  automação  .  Responsabilidades e atribuições    Criar e evoluir  módulos Terraform  para padronizar componentes da plataforma de dados (redes, IAM, storage, computação, pipelines etc.);   Arquitetar, desenvolver e manter  pipelines e processos ETL/ELT  , garantindo qualidade, escalabilidade e observabilidade;   Estabelecer padrões e boas práticas de  Data Ops  , incluindo versionamento, testes, deployments e monitoramento;   Dar suporte técnico e consultivo aos times de dados, ajudando a estruturar soluções robustas e alinhadas à arquitetura corporativa;  Implementar mecanismos de  governança  , segurança e otimização de custos em ambientes de dados na nuvem.    Requisitos obrigatórios    Experiência sólida com  Terraform  e infraestrutura como código;   Vivência prática em  cloud  (AWS, Azure ou GCP), especialmente em serviços de dados;   Forte conhecimento em  pipelines  ,  ETL/ELT  e arquiteturas de dados (Data Lake, DW, Lakehouse);   Proficiência em  Python  e  SQL;    Experiência com  CI/CD  aplicado a dados e automação;   Conhecimentos de containers (Docker) e, desejável, Kubernetes.    Diferenciais   Criação de bibliotecas ou módulos Terraform em escala corporativa;  Experiência com orquestradores como Airflow, Prefect, Dagster ou Step Functions;  Conhecimento de ferramentas de monitoramento e observabilidade (Cloud Watch, Grafana, Datadog);  Certificações cloud ou de engenharia de dados.    Perfil comportamental   Liderança técnica e capacidade de influenciar padrões e boas práticas;  Comunicação clara para dialogar com áreas técnicas e não técnicas;  Proatividade e visão sistêmica de plataforma.    BENEFÍ CIOS DESSA POSIÇÃ O   Participação em Lucros e Resultados;  Carro Corporativo;  Descontos em Aluguel, Assinatura e Compra de veículos;  Programa de Livre Escolha (Reembolso de Despesas Médicas);  Vale Alimentação e Refeição;  Allya;  Auxílio Home office;  Wellhub;  Plano de Saúde;  Plano Odontológico;  Seguro de Vida.

title: Senior web developer
description:
Nova oportunidade para Senior web developer em toledo. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

About the Role  We're looking for a Modern Web Developer to design, build, and ship high-quality websites across our agency group — primarily in Word Press and Hub Spot, but increasingly using AI-native build tools like Lovable, Claude Code, and Cursor.  This is not a classic Word Press role buried in PHP. We need someone who is technically broad and modern: comfortable in a CMS, fluent in modern Java Script and APIs, and excited to use AI coding tools to ship faster than a traditional dev shop. You'll build marketing sites, landing pages, and lightweight web apps — and just as often, wire those sites into the rest of our stack via APIs, webhooks, and automations.  If you love shipping polished, conversion-ready sites and you're allergic to bloated,  brittle Word Press builds, you'll fit right in.  Key Responsibilities   Website Development   Design and build production-grade marketing websites in Word Press (custom themes/blocks, ACF, headless setups where appropriate) and Hub Spot CMS (Hub L templating, modules, themes).  Use Lovable, Claude Code, Cursor, and similar AI-native tools to accelerate  prototyping and full builds — for client work and internal tools alike.  Build clean, performant, accessible front-end experiences (semantic HTML, modern CSS, vanilla JS or framework-as-needed).  Maintain and extend existing client sites: new pages, modules, redesigns, performance tuning, and migrations.    API Integrations & Automation Hooks   Integrate websites with Hub Spot, Salesforce, marketing automation platforms, analytics tools, and custom APIs.  Wire up form submissions, gated content, and lead routing to webhooks, n8n flows, and serverless functions.  Build lightweight internal tools, microsites, and utilities when a full CMS is overkill (Vercel, Netlify, Cloudflare Workers, etc.).    Quality, Performance & SEO   Own Core Web Vitals, page speed, schema markup, and on-page technical SEO basics for every site you ship.  Implement analytics and tracking correctly (GA4, GTM, Hub Spot tracking, server-side events where needed).  Test thoroughly across devices and browsers; care about the details.    Collaboration   Work directly with designers, strategists, and marketers to translate Figma into pixel-faithful, on-brand builds.  Participate in code reviews, version control workflows (Git/Git Hub), and documentation.  Help define internal standards for how we build sites across the agency group going forward.    Required Skills   Technical   3+ years building production websites in Word Press (custom themes, blocks, ACF, plugin selection and customization).  Strong Hub Spot CMS experience (Hub L, modules, themes, forms, smart content).  Proficient in HTML, CSS, Java Script — comfortable with modern tooling, build steps, and at least one JS framework when needed (React/Next.js a plus).  Hands-on experience with AI coding tools (Lovable, Claude Code, Cursor, Replit, or equivalent) — and a clear point of view on when to use them vs. when to write code yourself.  Solid understanding of REST APIs, webhooks, OAuth, and serverless functions.  Comfortable in Git/Git Hub with branching, PRs, and basic CI/CD.    Modern Web Skills   Performance optimization (Core Web Vitals, lazy loading, image optimization, caching strategies).  Technical SEO fundamentals (schema, sitemaps, redirects, canonical handling).  Accessibility basics (WCAG, semantic HTML, keyboard navigation).  Analytics and tag management (GA4, GTM, server-side tracking).    Bonus Experience   (Not required, but highly valuable) Webflow development experience.  Headless Word Press or Hub Spot setups (Next.js + WP/Hub Spot APIs).  Experience with Supabase, Postgres, or Firebase for lightweight app backends.  Familiarity with n8n, Make.com, or Zapier for stitching sites into broader workflows.  E-commerce experience (Woo Commerce, Shopify).  Design sensibility — you can read a Figma file and notice when something is off without being told.    Soft Skills   Bias toward shipping. You'd rather get a working v1 live than debate architecture for two weeks.  Detail-oriented — you care about pixel alignment, spacing, and typography as much as the underlying code.  Strong communicator with non-technical teammates; you can explain trade-offs to a strategist or account lead without jargon.  Curious about new tools and models — you experiment on your own time and bring ideas back to the team.  Comfortable juggling multiple sites and clients in a fast-moving agency environment.    What Success Looks Like   In the first 60–90 days, you will:  Ship at least 2–3 client websites or major redesigns end-to-end.  Establish standards for how we use AI coding tools across web builds (when to reach for Lovable, when to drop into Claude Code, when to write it ourselves).  Integrate at least one site deeply with our automation stack (Hub Spot, n8n, custom APIs) in a way that becomes a reusable pattern.  Become the internal go-to person for technical web questions across the agency group.

title: Senior web developer
description:
Nova oportunidade para Senior web developer em santana de parnaíba. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

About the Role  We're looking for a Modern Web Developer to design, build, and ship high-quality websites across our agency group — primarily in Word Press and Hub Spot, but increasingly using AI-native build tools like Lovable, Claude Code, and Cursor.  This is not a classic Word Press role buried in PHP. We need someone who is technically broad and modern: comfortable in a CMS, fluent in modern Java Script and APIs, and excited to use AI coding tools to ship faster than a traditional dev shop. You'll build marketing sites, landing pages, and lightweight web apps — and just as often, wire those sites into the rest of our stack via APIs, webhooks, and automations.  If you love shipping polished, conversion-ready sites and you're allergic to bloated,  brittle Word Press builds, you'll fit right in.  Key Responsibilities   Website Development   Design and build production-grade marketing websites in Word Press (custom themes/blocks, ACF, headless setups where appropriate) and Hub Spot CMS (Hub L templating, modules, themes).  Use Lovable, Claude Code, Cursor, and similar AI-native tools to accelerate  prototyping and full builds — for client work and internal tools alike.  Build clean, performant, accessible front-end experiences (semantic HTML, modern CSS, vanilla JS or framework-as-needed).  Maintain and extend existing client sites: new pages, modules, redesigns, performance tuning, and migrations.    API Integrations & Automation Hooks   Integrate websites with Hub Spot, Salesforce, marketing automation platforms, analytics tools, and custom APIs.  Wire up form submissions, gated content, and lead routing to webhooks, n8n flows, and serverless functions.  Build lightweight internal tools, microsites, and utilities when a full CMS is overkill (Vercel, Netlify, Cloudflare Workers, etc.).    Quality, Performance & SEO   Own Core Web Vitals, page speed, schema markup, and on-page technical SEO basics for every site you ship.  Implement analytics and tracking correctly (GA4, GTM, Hub Spot tracking, server-side events where needed).  Test thoroughly across devices and browsers; care about the details.    Collaboration   Work directly with designers, strategists, and marketers to translate Figma into pixel-faithful, on-brand builds.  Participate in code reviews, version control workflows (Git/Git Hub), and documentation.  Help define internal standards for how we build sites across the agency group going forward.    Required Skills   Technical   3+ years building production websites in Word Press (custom themes, blocks, ACF, plugin selection and customization).  Strong Hub Spot CMS experience (Hub L, modules, themes, forms, smart content).  Proficient in HTML, CSS, Java Script — comfortable with modern tooling, build steps, and at least one JS framework when needed (React/Next.js a plus).  Hands-on experience with AI coding tools (Lovable, Claude Code, Cursor, Replit, or equivalent) — and a clear point of view on when to use them vs. when to write code yourself.  Solid understanding of REST APIs, webhooks, OAuth, and serverless functions.  Comfortable in Git/Git Hub with branching, PRs, and basic CI/CD.    Modern Web Skills   Performance optimization (Core Web Vitals, lazy loading, image optimization, caching strategies).  Technical SEO fundamentals (schema, sitemaps, redirects, canonical handling).  Accessibility basics (WCAG, semantic HTML, keyboard navigation).  Analytics and tag management (GA4, GTM, server-side tracking).    Bonus Experience   (Not required, but highly valuable) Webflow development experience.  Headless Word Press or Hub Spot setups (Next.js + WP/Hub Spot APIs).  Experience with Supabase, Postgres, or Firebase for lightweight app backends.  Familiarity with n8n, Make.com, or Zapier for stitching sites into broader workflows.  E-commerce experience (Woo Commerce, Shopify).  Design sensibility — you can read a Figma file and notice when something is off without being told.    Soft Skills   Bias toward shipping. You'd rather get a working v1 live than debate architecture for two weeks.  Detail-oriented — you care about pixel alignment, spacing, and typography as much as the underlying code.  Strong communicator with non-technical teammates; you can explain trade-offs to a strategist or account lead without jargon.  Curious about new tools and models — you experiment on your own time and bring ideas back to the team.  Comfortable juggling multiple sites and clients in a fast-moving agency environment.    What Success Looks Like   In the first 60–90 days, you will:  Ship at least 2–3 client websites or major redesigns end-to-end.  Establish standards for how we use AI coding tools across web builds (when to reach for Lovable, when to drop into Claude Code, when to write it ourselves).  Integrate at least one site deeply with our automation stack (Hub Spot, n8n, custom APIs) in a way that becomes a reusable pattern.  Become the internal go-to person for technical web questions across the agency group.

title: Senior web developer
description:
Nova oportunidade para Senior web developer em cajamar. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

About the Role  We're looking for a Modern Web Developer to design, build, and ship high-quality websites across our agency group — primarily in Word Press and Hub Spot, but increasingly using AI-native build tools like Lovable, Claude Code, and Cursor.  This is not a classic Word Press role buried in PHP. We need someone who is technically broad and modern: comfortable in a CMS, fluent in modern Java Script and APIs, and excited to use AI coding tools to ship faster than a traditional dev shop. You'll build marketing sites, landing pages, and lightweight web apps — and just as often, wire those sites into the rest of our stack via APIs, webhooks, and automations.  If you love shipping polished, conversion-ready sites and you're allergic to bloated,  brittle Word Press builds, you'll fit right in.  Key Responsibilities   Website Development   Design and build production-grade marketing websites in Word Press (custom themes/blocks, ACF, headless setups where appropriate) and Hub Spot CMS (Hub L templating, modules, themes).  Use Lovable, Claude Code, Cursor, and similar AI-native tools to accelerate  prototyping and full builds — for client work and internal tools alike.  Build clean, performant, accessible front-end experiences (semantic HTML, modern CSS, vanilla JS or framework-as-needed).  Maintain and extend existing client sites: new pages, modules, redesigns, performance tuning, and migrations.    API Integrations & Automation Hooks   Integrate websites with Hub Spot, Salesforce, marketing automation platforms, analytics tools, and custom APIs.  Wire up form submissions, gated content, and lead routing to webhooks, n8n flows, and serverless functions.  Build lightweight internal tools, microsites, and utilities when a full CMS is overkill (Vercel, Netlify, Cloudflare Workers, etc.).    Quality, Performance & SEO   Own Core Web Vitals, page speed, schema markup, and on-page technical SEO basics for every site you ship.  Implement analytics and tracking correctly (GA4, GTM, Hub Spot tracking, server-side events where needed).  Test thoroughly across devices and browsers; care about the details.    Collaboration   Work directly with designers, strategists, and marketers to translate Figma into pixel-faithful, on-brand builds.  Participate in code reviews, version control workflows (Git/Git Hub), and documentation.  Help define internal standards for how we build sites across the agency group going forward.    Required Skills   Technical   3+ years building production websites in Word Press (custom themes, blocks, ACF, plugin selection and customization).  Strong Hub Spot CMS experience (Hub L, modules, themes, forms, smart content).  Proficient in HTML, CSS, Java Script — comfortable with modern tooling, build steps, and at least one JS framework when needed (React/Next.js a plus).  Hands-on experience with AI coding tools (Lovable, Claude Code, Cursor, Replit, or equivalent) — and a clear point of view on when to use them vs. when to write code yourself.  Solid understanding of REST APIs, webhooks, OAuth, and serverless functions.  Comfortable in Git/Git Hub with branching, PRs, and basic CI/CD.    Modern Web Skills   Performance optimization (Core Web Vitals, lazy loading, image optimization, caching strategies).  Technical SEO fundamentals (schema, sitemaps, redirects, canonical handling).  Accessibility basics (WCAG, semantic HTML, keyboard navigation).  Analytics and tag management (GA4, GTM, server-side tracking).    Bonus Experience   (Not required, but highly valuable) Webflow development experience.  Headless Word Press or Hub Spot setups (Next.js + WP/Hub Spot APIs).  Experience with Supabase, Postgres, or Firebase for lightweight app backends.  Familiarity with n8n, Make.com, or Zapier for stitching sites into broader workflows.  E-commerce experience (Woo Commerce, Shopify).  Design sensibility — you can read a Figma file and notice when something is off without being told.    Soft Skills   Bias toward shipping. You'd rather get a working v1 live than debate architecture for two weeks.  Detail-oriented — you care about pixel alignment, spacing, and typography as much as the underlying code.  Strong communicator with non-technical teammates; you can explain trade-offs to a strategist or account lead without jargon.  Curious about new tools and models — you experiment on your own time and bring ideas back to the team.  Comfortable juggling multiple sites and clients in a fast-moving agency environment.    What Success Looks Like   In the first 60–90 days, you will:  Ship at least 2–3 client websites or major redesigns end-to-end.  Establish standards for how we use AI coding tools across web builds (when to reach for Lovable, when to drop into Claude Code, when to write it ourselves).  Integrate at least one site deeply with our automation stack (Hub Spot, n8n, custom APIs) in a way that becomes a reusable pattern.  Become the internal go-to person for technical web questions across the agency group.

This leading multinational group, with significant operations across the Americas and worldwide, is seeking an experienced Forensic Manager to lead a team of corporate investigators across their regional operations. Based in Belo Horizonte, you will be responsible for managing a team of forensic specialists who are overseeing investigations into complex financial crimes, including conflict-of-interest, procurement fraud, misappropriation of assets, corruption, and bribery.  Your role will be primarily focused on team leadership, setting key performance objectives, and building strategic relationships to ensure seamless regional operations. In addition to your leadership duties, you will undertake high-level corporate investigation projects, conduct fraud awareness training, and oversee the integration of data analytics into investigative workflows.  To be successful in this role, you should possess extensive experience in leading complex corporate investigations and managing specialized forensic teams. You are likely currently working in a managerial capacity within a forensic advisory firm or a comparable corporate business.  While a CFE qualification is highly welcomed, we value your proven ability to lead high-performance teams and manage senior stakeholder relationships. Excellent communication skills are essential, and candidates must be fluent in both Portuguese and English. Proficiency in Spanish and experience with advanced data analytics tools are welcomed. Senior Out Systems Engineer  About the Role   We are seeking a Senior Out Systems Engineer to lead platform stabilization and migration readiness efforts for a large-scale clinical application supporting 130+ locations nationwide. This is a highly hands-on, high-impact role focused on improving system performance, reducing risk, and preparing the platform for an eventual transition to a custom-built solution.  This engagement is expected to begin late April or early May and run approximately 6 weeks, with strong potential for extension based on performance. integrations impacting system performance  Reduce Error Noise and Improve Observability   Identify and remediate recurring error patterns masking real issues  Refactor exception handling and client-side lifecycle violations  Establish a clean, monitorable baseline for system health  Build a Real Release Pipeline   Establish a true multi-environment deployment pipeline  Configure deployment automation using Out Systems APIs  Implement gated release processes with approvals and controls  Ensure non-production environments support meaningful regression testing  Manage Platform Capacity and Licensing   Audit platform usage and identify optimization opportunities  Remove unused or redundant components  Define governance for capacity-impacting changes  Extend platform headroom without impacting functionality  Prepare for Migration to Custom Platform   Document all integrations including triggers, data contracts, and failure modes  Map data entities into portable schemas  Capture business logic embedded within the platform  Identify core business logic vs platform-generated components  Advise on migration sequencing and risk across workflows  What You Bring   Required Experience   5+ years building and maintaining enterprise-scale Out Systems applications  Deep experience with Out Systems 11, Service Studio, and Lifetime API  Proven success optimizing performance including query tuning and data model improvements  Experience refactoring complex, tightly coupled systems into modular architectures  Strong SQL Server performance tuning experience including execution plans and indexing  Hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines and deployment automation within Out Systems  Strong problem-solving skills in live production environments  Preferred Experience considerations and secure data handling  Experience with license optimization and application object management  Knowledge of integration patterns across scheduling, e-signature, or CRM systems  Working Environment   Collaborate closely with internal engineering and PM leadership  Operate with high autonomy and ownership of technical decisions  Work within a live production environment supporting critical clinical operations  Balance speed and precision while minimizing risk to end users  This is a unique opportunity to step into a complex, high-visibility system, make immediate impact, and shape the foundation for a next-generation platform.

title: Gerente de projetos de ti sênior
description:
Nova oportunidade para Gerente de projetos de ti sênior em franco da rocha. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

Sobre a WWS  Somos uma consultoria de TI especializada em conectar profissionais de alta performance a projetos estratégicos em grandes organizações. Nosso propósito é equilibrar eficiência operacional e inovação, gerando valor real para os negócios e construindo um futuro sólido e competitivo para nossos clientes.  Sobre a vaga   Esta é uma oportunidade para atuar como Gerente de Projetos de TI em um ambiente de alta complexidade e grande escala no setor de Agronegócio.  Você será o elo entre times técnicos e áreas de negócio, liderando entregas que impactam diretamente a operação de uma das maiores empresas do setor. É um papel estratégico, que exige visão sistêmica, governança e capacidade de tomada de decisão em projetos críticos.  Responsabilidades   Gestão de Portfólio: Estruturar, monitorar e reportar indicadores de desempenho (KPIs) e status de múltiplos projetos, garantindo aderência a cronogramas, custos e escopo.  Background Técnico: Orientar times e conduzir projetos de implementação, evolução e integração de sistemas ERP (e idealmente WMS), mapeando riscos e dependências.  Relacionamento com Negócio: Atuar como ponto focal para áreas de negócio (operações, logística, supply chain), traduzindo necessidades em entregas de TI.  Governança e Processos: Aplicar boas práticas de gerenciamento de projetos (PMBOK, Ágil ou Híbrido), gestão de mudanças e qualidade.    Requisitos   Experiência comprovada como Gerente de Projetos de TI em médias/grandes empresas.  Domínio sólido em projetos ERP (SAP, Oracle, Totvs, ou similares).  Conhecimento em WMS.  Familiaridade com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban) e tradicionais (Cascata).  Capacidade de gestão de stakeholders e fornecedores externos.    Informações Adicionais   Regime de Contratação: PJ (pessoa jurídica) Local de Trabalho: Remoto (Brasil) Viagens: Pontuais (a combinar, com custos cobertos) Setor da Cliente: Agronegócio (grande porte) Diferencial: Vivência em projetos de cadeia de suprimentos, logística ou operações agroindustriais.

title: Direct-response creative strategist
description:
Confira a vaga para Direct-response creative strategist em araraquara. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

About us Clickbait Agency is a You Tube ad creative and media buying agency. We only work with 8 and 9-figure DTC brands and our focus is simple, producing video creatives that scale profitably on You Tube and this means that you’ll be working directly on accounts most agencies don’t get near.  We care deeply about being the best at what we do which means fast iteration, high standards, and creatives that spend millions. We’ve built proprietary AI systems that support our creative and production workflows, and our video production runs through a dedicated team of AI prompters, so strategists can stay focused on strategy.  We think You Tube creative is going through a significant shift right now and we’re positioning ourselves at the front of it.  The role  We’re looking for a creative strategist who understands direct response at a serious level and can develop and script You Tube ads and mini VSLs for competitive ecommerce markets.  You’ll be responsible for research, angle development, hook writing, scripting, and iterating based on performance data. Your scripts go through our AI production team, so the output is fast and the feedback loop is short.  You’ll be working across multiple 8 and 9-figure brands simultaneously. The work is demanding and the bar is high.  What we’re looking for  We’re only looking for people who are genuinely good at this. If you’re earlier in your career or still developing your DR fundamentals, this isn’t the right fit yet.  You should have:  2+ years writing direct response video ads for You Tube or Facebook  A real understanding of Eugene Schwartz’s awareness stages and how to apply them to cold traffic  Experience scripting hooks, mini VSLs, and full ad concepts  The ability to look at performance data and use it to build the next creative  Proven spend behind your work — creatives you’ve written that have run profitably at scale  Comfort using AI tools as part of your day-to-day workflow    Experience in compliance-sensitive categories like supplements or weight loss is a bonus. So is familiarity with unique mechanism development and RMBC.  What we offer  Base salary with a performance bonus tied to winning creatives. When your work scales, your compensation reflects that.  You’ll have access to proprietary AI tools built specifically for our workflow, a production team that handles execution, and a team around you that takes the work seriously.  This is a fully remote position.  One thing worth knowing  There’s a short test task as part of the application process. It’s there to see how you think, not to take your time for nothing.  Apply Here:
